title: Optimized Panda
description: An optimization modpack with a few quality of life features!
body:
## Overview
this modpack is perfect for people who want more fps in minecraft! and it includes support for shaders! it also has a few extra features such as falling leaves and explosive enhancement.

i've personally been using all the mods in this modpack for a long time now and i've spent countless hours researching mods and optimizing settings for the best minecraft experience!

optimized panda can turn your game from unplayable to getting 100+ fps even on integrated graphics!

## Features
- Ultimate Performance
- Shader Support
- Fresh Animations
- Connected Textures
- Falling Leaves
- FreeCam (ask server owner or staff before using on a server)
- Zoom
